newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-PacDun says Ansell wins U.S. contract.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-PacDun says Ansell wins U.S. contract.

text.p: Pacific Dunlop Ltd said on Tuesday its Ansell rubber products division has won a five year contract to supply surgical and examination gloves to U.S. hospital group Premier Inc.
The contract was worth A$120 million over five years, effectively doubling Ansell's existing sales to Premier, Pacific Dunlop managing director Rod Chadwick said in a statement.

The low protein, powder free gloves selected by Premier, represented the fastest growing category in the market for thin barrier protection in medical applications, Ansell managing director Harry Boon said.

The 1,850 members of the Premier group account for one in every three surgical procedures performed in the United States, generating combined annual revenues of more than US$70 billion, Pacific Dunlop said.
At 0356 GMT (2.56 p.m.) Pacific Dunlop shares were down eight cents to A$2.72.
